# Technology Strategy, Execution & Governance — Alexandro Sances

> Independent professional reference repository on technology strategy and governance, enterprise AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), digital portfolio governance, open-source strategy, digital infrastructure and sustainability.

The documentation website is generated from the Markdown files in the public GitHub repository. GitHub is the canonical source for content, revisions, licensing and change history; the website is a read-optimised publication of that source.

## Start here

- [Main guide](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/): purpose, governance model, reading path and author context.
- [Frameworks index](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/): connected reference frameworks.
- [Templates index](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/): operational templates and examples.

## Core governance frameworks

- [Technology Strategy & Execution Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/technology-strategy-execution-governance/): connects strategic outcomes, capabilities, technology choices, investment, delivery and benefits.
- [Strategy & Execution Governance Playbook](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/strategy-execution-governance-playbook/): decision rights, prioritisation, mandate, steering, escalation and benefits.
- [Digital Portfolio Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/digital-portfolio-governance/): investment selection, capacity, dependencies, sequencing and rebalancing.

## Strategic technology domains

- [Enterprise AI & RAG Governance Blueprint](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/enterprise-ai-rag-governance-blueprint/): information readiness, source governance, access control, evaluation, human oversight and lifecycle risk.
- [Open Source Strategy & Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/open-source-strategy-governance/): ecosystem health, dependencies, licensing, supply-chain evidence, stewardship, contribution and exit.
- [Digital Sustainability and Data Centre Energy Governance](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/frameworks/digital-sustainability-data-centre-governance/): service demand, infrastructure capacity, energy, water, resilience and lifecycle economics.

## Operational templates and examples

- [Initiative Canvas](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/initiative-canvas/): initiative framing and mandate.
- [Initiative Canvas — Fictional Example](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/initiative-canvas-example/): completed illustrative scenario; all organisations and results are fictional.
- [Weighted Scoring Matrix](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/weighted-scoring-matrix/): comparison of discretionary options.
- [Decision Record](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/decision-record/): rationale, authority, conditions and review triggers.
- [Decision Record — Fictional Example](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/decision-record-example/): illustrative decision record, not an actual organisational decision.
- [Governance Forums](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/governance-forums/): decision classes, forum charters and escalation.
- [RACI Matrix](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/raci-matrix/): responsibility and accountability.
- [Escalation and Status](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/escalation-and-status/): tolerances, escalation briefs, status reporting and RAID tracking.
- [Executive Checklists](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/executive-checklists/): governance checks for investment, delivery and operation.
- [Benefit Profile](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/benefit-profile/): baseline, target, ownership, attribution and review.
- [Strategic Dependency Register](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/strategic-dependency-register/): cross-initiative dependencies and responses.
- [KPI Dictionary](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/kpi-dictionary/): measure definitions, owners and decision use.
- [KPI Reference](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/kpi-reference/): domain-specific measures.
- [AI/RAG Use-Case Assessment](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/ai-rag-use-case-assessment/): use-case suitability, information sources, threat modelling and evaluation.
- [Open-Source Assessment](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/open-source-assessment/): option assessment, governance health, participation and exit readiness.
- [Infrastructure Capacity Decision](https://a13xandr0.github.io/A13xandr0/templates/infrastructure-capacity-decision/): capacity options, measurement boundaries and decision gates.

## Interpretation and provenance

- Frameworks describe governance principles and operating models; templates are adaptable working artefacts.
- Worked examples are fictional illustrations, not evidence of actual implementations, decisions, measured performance or achieved results.
- Scores, thresholds, estimates and targets must be validated in the user's organisational context.
- The material is independent professional guidance, not legal, financial, security, procurement or regulatory advice.
- Author: Alexandro Sances.
- [Canonical source repository](https://github.com/A13xandr0/A13xandr0).
- [Professional profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexandrosances/).
